<thought>The 1H NMR shows a single aromatic multiplet integrating to 10 H, indicating two equivalent phenyl rings. The 13C NMR displays a carbonyl carbon at ~196 ppm and aromatic carbons consistent with a symmetric diphenyl ketone. This matches benzophenone (SMILES: O=C(c1ccccc1)c2ccccc2). No other functional‑group signals are present. Therefore the SMILES string is:

O=C(c1ccccc1)c2ccccc2

<thought>We have determined the SMILES.</thought>
<final_answer>O=C(c1ccccc1)c2ccccc2</final_answer>
